## DG2 round 13, domain review: verdict FAIL

I'm failing the gate on one new High finding, F-DG2-480. It's a web-client defect, and on the playbook content itself the candidate is faithful.

**Candidate checks:** the candidate ID (`sha256:6824b8b8…`, 556 files) matches in the repo and in a fresh clone, before and after my runs. HEAD `5699f721` is the freeze commit on source `aa0a68f1`. The DG1 historical gate passes.

**Playbook fidelity: all 26 requirements are met.** I checked the source texts against `docs/source/playbook.md` and walked them live in English and Arabic. Two labels are not word-for-word, and I accepted both:
- "Business Owners" and "Workstream Leads" are named in the singular for a per-person role; the accountability text is verbatim.
- The charter field "Top 3-5 outcomes" is labelled "Top outcomes"; the 3-5 count appears in the guidance and warning text.

Other points:
- G1, G2 and G3 can only be decided in order, and I approved all three live on synthetic data.
- There is exactly one current North Star, and G2 is blocked when there are no guardrails.
- Value pools with no amount are labelled "unquantified", never shown as 0. Money uses decimals.
- The brand is shown as provisional, nothing claims PMI or Mobily certification, and the product gates never touch DG0–DG7.

**Checks on Node 22 and 24:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck | passed |
| build | passed |
| lint | passed (see note) |
| test | 796/796 passed |
| contrast | passed |

The first Node 24 lint run failed, but only on my own probe scripts, which I had put inside the clone. With them moved out, lint passed on both versions.

**The three D-073 repairs work on the server side:**
- **Upload while access is withdrawn or the user signs out:** refused (403 when access lapses, 401 when revoked or signed out), nothing stored and no partial file left. A later upload works.
- **Sign-in:** dev login works for every synthetic user and in the browser in both languages.
- **Shutdown during an upload:** the server exits cleanly with no partial file. After a restart, evidence uploads and downloads unchanged.

### Finding

| ID | Severity | Mandatory | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG2-480 | High | No | frontend-ux-engineer |

When a session ends while the app is open, the web client gets stuck in an endless redirect loop. That covers the new upload refusal, an administrator's revocation and a sign-out in another tab:
- The page bounces between the sign-in page and the original page, showing a blank screen.
- There is no sign-in form and no localized "session ended" message.
- The tab sends about 130–140 session checks per second.
- Only a manual browser reload gets the user out.

With the product's default rate limits it gets worse. After about 2 seconds the tab uses up the request limit for its IP address. It then shows the signed-out user the app with their old name and "Too many requests". Other sign-ins from that IP are refused for the rest of the minute.

The cause is in `LoginPage.tsx` (`if (me.data)` uses the last cached identity) together with `RequireSession` in `session.tsx`. This code dates from DG1 (`4cd9224`), so the defect is older than this round; D-073 didn't change the web, but its new 401 on uploads leads users into it. I reproduced it in English and Arabic, with and without an upload, and with the default limits. A page reload is the control and recovers every time.

### Other notes
- Every failed run in my logs is explained in the record and in `env.txt`. They are either my own probe mistakes (attempt logs kept) or symptoms of F-DG2-480.
- I did not exercise the OIDC/Keycloak sign-in path live; it isn't available in dev mode (known residual D-049).
- The assignment asked for the handback in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/`, but the write guard doesn't let this role write there. As in round 12, it is at `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-13/handback-T-DG2-REV-DOM-R13-domain-reviewer.md`.
- I did not open any other reviewer's round-13 record. The disposable clone and scratch files have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-13/`:
- domain-reviewer.json
- domain-reviewer.findings.json
- domain-reviewer.md
